provenance.origin: User-supplied MetalForge screenshot, screen recording, and configured URL
provenance.creator: MetalForge
provenance.usageNotes: The recording is motion authority, the screenshot is static authority, and URL parameters are supporting evidence only. Generated WebGPU source is locked; source parity is not claimed.

views.description: Supplied 52 percent state and deterministic PNG measurements.
views.visibleScope: Geometry, content placement, colour hierarchy, and settled front.

views.description: Supplied 22.767-second H.264 motion reference sampled once per second.
views.visibleScope: Three traversals, direction reversal, shape evolution, endpoint holds, and attached haze.
Parameter names and supplied values only; no units, equations, or implementation semantics.

registryScope.notes: Specification only. No prototype or production target is authorised.

visibleObservations.fact: The bar occupies x=55, y=52, width=1950, height=262 in the 2118 by 394 screenshot, a 7.44 to 1 aspect ratio.
An uppercase feature block is inside the left side and a large percentage is inside the right side; both are stationary and crisp.
The unfilled point sample is RGB 32,32,35 and the front point sample is RGB 80,155,248; the front crop reaches RGB 190,253,254.
The recording shows 0 to 100, 100 to 0, and 0 to 100 traversals at different visible rates, followed by endpoint holds.
The attached luminous front changes between rounded lobes and concave pinches during travel; a broad haze stays behind it and no detached trail is visible.
At zero the front disappears into the left edge; at 100 it clips and compresses against the rounded right edge.

repositoryEvidence.claim: The slider contract preserves continuous tonal and colour adjustment, visible values, native semantics, and functional gradients.
Chromasmith defines Mist Blue and Slate Blue action roles by theme.
Chromasmith uses SF Pro Text and SF Mono interface stacks.
Color Mixer HSL controls currently expose functional gradients through native range inputs.

applicableDesignRules.rule: Use existing Chroma colour roles and preserve functional gradients.
Preserve Chroma typography rather than copying unknown raster font metrics.
Reduced-motion mode removes lag, wave evolution, pulsing, and settle animation.
The semantic native input and visible focus treatment remain intact.

proposedInterpretations.statement: Keep labels, values, focus, and the native range in HTML/CSS; render only the filled region, attached haze, and deforming front in a shared Canvas 2D layer.
Use one panel-level Canvas and scheduler instead of one WebGL context or animated SVG filter per slider.

Prototype direct tracking during pointer drag, 120 to 220 milliseconds of visual catch-up for programmatic or keyboard changes, and at most 120 milliseconds of deformation settle; these values are not measured from MetalForge.

userDecisions.decision: Produce static and motion specification for approval and do not implement yet.
Treat the recording as motion reference and URL parameters as supporting evidence.
Preserve Chroma typography and existing slider behavior.

unresolvedQuestions.question: Should a future isolated prototype preserve the 7.44 to 1 reference density or adapt it to a compact Color-panel row?
Should a future prototype cover all Color sliders or selected primary controls only?

geometrySpacing.statement: Use the measured 7.44 to 1 bar proportion as the reference silhouette; exact radius and production density remain unresolved.

typography.statement: Place existing feature/context copy and canonical value inside the bar using Chroma SF Pro Text/SF Mono tokens; do not infer the reference font.

colorsContrastRoles.statement: Map the dark fill, luminous core, and haze hierarchy onto Chroma surface/Slate/Mist roles while retaining functional HSL information.

motionInteraction.statement: Front deformation scales with movement, remains attached, narrows after settle, reverses continuously, and clips/compresses at both endpoints with no detached trail.

responsiveBehavior.statement: A future prototype must keep internal text legible and inside the bar through the complete Color-panel width and resizer matrix; the reference supplies no narrow layout.

accessibility.statement: The existing native range owns semantics and behavior; visual duplicates are hidden from accessibility APIs and focus stays crisp outside the effect.

targets.statement: Specification only. If prototype approval is later granted, bind an isolated study to the Color slider contract without modifying production targets.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Feature/context and canonical value remain crisp and inside the bar at min, default, max, both themes, and every supported Color-panel width.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Focused browser screenshots and bounding-box assertions.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The front remains attached, deforms only while moving/settling, reverses continuously, and compresses at both endpoints with no trail.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Side-by-side 60 fps recording against the supplied motion reference.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Pointer, keyboard, Home/End, steps, input/change events, undo, persistence, focus, and functional gradients match current slider behavior.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Existing behavior suite plus focused Color tests.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: One shared scheduler animates only active/settling controls; p95 draw cost is at most 1 ms per frame on the supported desktop baseline and idle CPU returns to zero effect work.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Running-app performance trace with the complete visible slider inventory.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Reduced motion snaps immediately, uses a static narrow boundary, and schedules no animation after paint.

evidence.statement: Retain the deterministic screenshot hash, RGBA point samples, and analyst-selected crop statistics.
Retain recording metadata, one-second displayed-value samples, traversal intervals, and explicit measurement limits.
